strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis gaw Y1 zawn re ai player ni a matu (6.0, 7.0, 8.0 zawn re ai makoi da ai board revision ni hpe yaw shada ai) n-nan ai firmware ni hpe ayan shapraw ya ai rai nna, dai gaw moi na device ni hpe atsin sha jahten kau ya ai. Grau sawng ai gaw, shanhte a website gaw, bricked state kaw na bai hkam kaja wa na matu, shawng na bungli galaw ai firmware ni hpe zero sadi jaw ai lam hte zero access jaw ai. Updater CE hte Community Firmware masing gaw daw ni hpe hkap la ai: anhte gaw legacy stock ROM shagu hpe archive galaw nna, na a hardware hpe gram lajang ai lam hpe shi hkrai shi jep yu nna, na a player hpe shim lum ai hku galaw shangun ai.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Hpaga galaw ai ni matut hkawm sa wa ai shaloi, wuhpung wuhpawng gaw rawt jat wa ai.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Broken Player ni hpe hkye la ai: Hkamja lam hpe jep yu ai shaloi, update nnan ni gaw hardware dingsa ni hpe galoi mung n jahten kau ya ai.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: Archive galaw da ai Stock ROM ni: Innioasis hpe yeng seng kau sai, npawt nhpang n-gun rawng ai firmware ni hpe tup hkrak mahkawng da ai.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: MacOS, Linux, Windows ni a matu mung hkum tsup ai hku htoi tu ai arung arai ni hpe lang ai.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware hpaji: Board hpe shi hkrai shi mu lu ai majaw galoi mung ra ai package hpe lu la na re.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Na a device hpe nsen n pru ai hardware trap ni hte hkrat sum ai revision ni kaw na makawp maga ya ai.
strings.support_story_2_body: Innioasis software hpe hkan tam ai gaw, aten htum mat sai Google Drive link ni, si mat sai Baidu sumwi share ni, n-gun n rawng ai mau hpa zip file ni hpe forum ni hta tam sawk sagawn ai lachyum rai nga ai. Anhte gaw kam mai ai, shanglawt ai download network hpe SHA-256 a dinghpring ai lam hpe jep chyoi da ai, update galaw ai ndau shana ai lam ni, lahkam mi hpang lahkam mi lam matsun ai install ni hpe galaw da ai. Na a alu gumhpraw ni gaw, ndai hpe galaw lu hkra galaw ya ai download ni hte hosting ni hpe, laning mi hta nhtoi 365 ya tup, hkying hkum 24 tup hkrak sha tawn da ya ai.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Google Drive ni hkrat sum ai lam n nga ai. Guess-bungli n galaw ai. Firmware bungli galaw nga ai sha re.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Lawan ai, hkrak sha n-gun n rawng ai sha, n-gun n rawng ai link ni hpe n-gun jaw ai.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Community nnan shapraw ai (sh) gram lajang ai lam ni hkrat sum mat ai aten hta sadi jaw u.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Lahkam mi hpang lahkam mi hku nna install galaw ai: Button dip shagu hta asan sha mu lu ai sumla ni gaw nang hpe hkawm sa shangun ai.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Ga amyu myu shaga ai wuhpung wuhpawng: English, Miwa, German, Spain, French & Japan ga ni hpe tup hkrak chye shaga ai.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Lawan ai, jep chyoi da ai wuhpung wuhpawng a npawt nhpang gawgap lam hpe nang teng sha kam hpa mai ai.
strings.support_story_3_body: Stock factory software gaw na a Y1 (sh) Y2 hardware galaw lu ai lam ni hpe npu kaw sha shinggrup kau ya ai. Anhte a buga hpung gaw Rockbox, n-gun n law ai htunghking hku galaw ai ladat ni, audiophile codec hpe nsen shapoi ai, htunghking hku galaw ai gabaw ni hpe asak hkrung shangun ai. Anhte gaw physical hardware amyu myu hpe n-gun n rawng ai sha mari la nna, chyam yu na matu, nhtang engineer galaw na matu, install shagu hpe jep joi ai lam galaw ga ai. Updater CE hpe madi shadaw ai gaw ndai chyam dinglik unit ni hpe hkrak gumhpraw jaw nna, custom firmware hpe lawan ladan galaw shapraw ya ai.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Na a Innioasis player a atsam marai yawng hpe hpaw ya ai.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Second loi mi laman hta nsen hpe madat ya lu nna, tinang ra sharawng ai theme ni hpe mung install galaw ya lu ai.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Battery hpe grau kaja hkra galaw ya ai, UI hpe grau san seng hkra galaw ya ai, dai ni na aten na nsen codec hpe madi shadaw ya ai.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Anhte gaw gara build hpe mung n shapraw shi yang, tengman ai hkum hkrang jak ni hpe chyam yu ga ai.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% manu jahpu n jaw ra ai, shimlam hpe shawng tawn ai software rai nna, ndau shana ai lam n nga ai, hkan tam ai lam n nga ai.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Rockbox, htunghking hku n-gun n rawng ai operating system ni, hte audiophile lawt lu lam ni hpe la sa wa ai.
strings.support_story_4_body: Hardware company langai mi gaw shanhte a hpang na gadget de htawt sit wa ai shaloi, moi na model ni hpe kau da kau ai. Innioasis gaw Linux hpe madi shadaw ai lam n nga ai, asan sha galai shai ai lam ni hpe n jaw ai, install galaw ai shaloi loi ai hku bai gram lajang na lam n nga ai. Updater CE nga ai gaw, myit rawt ai lang ai ni gaw hkum tsup ai kaja ai music player hpe kabai kau ra na n re ai majaw re. Ndai ladat hpe yawng a matu hpaw tawn da na matu, wuhpung wuhpawng ni a alu gumhpraw 100% gaw hkrak sha sa wa ai.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Innioasis ni n galaw ai hpe galaw na matu karum ya rit.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Device ni n hpaw ai sha pyi, sakse hkam da ai bai gram lajang ai lam gaw lwi nga ai.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux hpe shawng ningnan lang madi shadaw ya ai: Linux distros ni hta MediaTek flash hpe tup hkrak madi shadaw ya ai.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Gara galai shai ai lam ni hpe hkrak chye lu hkra, shapraw ai laika ni hpe hkrak tup ka da ai.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Coffee shagu gaw, archive hpe hpaw tawn da nna, yawng a matu manu jahpu n jaw ra ai.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Na a jak ni hpe nhprang arai kabai kau ai shara kaw na tsan gang hkra, wuhpung wuhpawng kaw nna galaw ai firmware hpe makawp maga ai lam.
